headline: Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro sets an all-time record while DeepSeek keeps its grip on the top
summary: Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro set a new all-time token-share high at 2.5% after jumping 12 places to No. 10. Meanwhile DeepSeek still holds 39.8% of tokens, and DeepSeek and OpenAI together account for 48.3%.
highlights: Kimi K3.1 Pro hit an all-time record token share of 2.5%, climbing 12 places in a day to rank 10.
NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Super VL (free) also set an all-time high, at 1.8% token share.
DeepSeek remains the heavyweight at 39.8% provider share, with deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 still at No. 1.
DeepSeek and OpenAI together hold 48.3%, the top-two cumulative share.
New entrants: Qwen 3.6 35B A3B, Upstage Solar Pro 4, and Mistral Nemo. Dropouts include Poolside Laguna S 2.1 and OpenAI GPT-6 Astra.
